description: Uncertainty-aware mixture-of-experts (MoE) classifier for breast lesions in H&E histopathology. A learned soft top-2 router mixes three pathology foundation-model experts (UNI, Virchow2, domain-adapted Phikon-v2) into a shared 512-d representation, classified as benign / atypical / malignant. Unlike image-input bundles, this bundle takes pre-computed foundation-model embeddings as input (one float32 vector per expert per tile/ROI); the foundation models themselves are gated on Hugging Face and are not distributed here, and the images are not redistributed. The shipped weights are the single-seed (seed 0) MoE head trained on the BRACS official train split. The metrics below are the paper's headline 5-seed ensemble results on the BRACS official test split (570 ROIs); the shipped single-seed checkpoint's own test metrics are to be confirmed (see docs/README.md). Research use only, not for diagnostic purposes.
image_classes: Pre-computed pathology foundation-model embeddings, float32, one vector per H&E tile/ROI: UNI 1024-d (CLS token), Virchow2 2560-d (CLS + mean patch token), domain-adapted Phikon-v2 1024-d (CLS token). Raw (unnormalised) embedding components; observed UNI components on BRACS train fall in [-0.19, 0.19].
intended_use: Research use only. This is an example, not to be used for diagnostic purposes. Noncommercial use under the PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0 (see LICENSE).
label_classes: three classes: benign, atypical, malignant, as indices 0, 1, 2 (one-hot [1, 0, 0], [0, 1, 0], [0, 0, 1]).
name: Breast lesion MoE classification
references: Toward reliable early breast lesion detection: a state-of-the-art, uncertainty-aware diagnostic engine with agentic decision support in H&E histopathology (under review). Code, weights and results: https://github.com/eliem08/paper_code
Foundation-model experts: UNI, Virchow2 and Phikon-v2 (gated on Hugging Face; see docs/data_license.txt)
task: Breast lesion classification in H&E histopathology (BRACS 3-class)
